title: BATON capability manifest
description: The `capabilities.yaml` a node reads at startup and advertises in its `hello` frame. This is a declaration of what the node offers, not a grant: the control plane still decides whether a capability may be registered, and an operator still decides whether it is enabled.

name.description: Dotted namespace, e.g. sys.echo, git.repository.diff, crm.customer.search. At least one dot: a bare verb tells a reader nothing about what it touches.

risk.description: low: read-only and bounded. confirm: needs a human decision before it runs. blocked: never automatic. When in doubt the answer is confirm — a capability that turns out to be safe can be downgraded, but one that was assumed safe cannot be un-invoked.

inputs.description: JSON Schema for the input object.

outputs.description: JSON Schema for the output object.

allow_from.description: Origins permitted to invoke this. Absent means local only — the safe default, since a capability reachable from the public network by accident is exactly the failure this field exists to prevent.

allow_data_egress.description: Whether results from this capability may leave the local network.
